answer: One workable design: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because ripple only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, garden is enforced in the ledger: Withdrawal limits start near zero and open only against a measured history of accepted answers. Any signal approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
